description.value: The Cove is a cafe located at Earl's Cove on the Sunshine Coast Highway, a community that serves as a BC Ferries terminal for the Earls Cove–Saltery Bay route. Its position on this key cycling corridor makes it a natural stop for touring cyclists navigating the Sunshine Coast. The current status of its website is uncertain, as the domain appears to be listed for sale.
